speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you're experiencing dizziness, nausea, and imbalance; to help me understand your condition better, can you tell me if these symptoms started suddenly or developed gradually? Also, have you noticed any hearing loss or ringing in your ears?

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. He occasionally feels nauseous and has taken diphenhydramine to help him sleep, which also alleviates his symptoms slightly. He mentions recent increased intake of garlic due to trying to recover from a cold a few days ago. Past medical history is unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the constant, low-grade spinning sensation and slight relief with diphenhydramine suggest a vestibular origin. Given your recent increased garlic intake and lack of hearing loss, this could be related to a toxin or an inner ear issue like BPPV or vestibular neuritis.
